defmodule MultiTenant.Auth do
  @moduledoc """
  Multi-tenant authentication library with tenant isolation.
  Supports configurable username policies per tenant.
  """

  defmodule TenantConfig do
    @moduledoc "Stores per-tenant configuration including validation rules."
    defstruct [:tenant_id, :name, :username_policy, :password_policy, :max_sessions]

    @default_username_policy ~r/^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{3,64}$/
    @default_password_policy %{min_length: 12, require_special: true}

    def default_config(tenant_id) do
      %__MODULE__{
        tenant_id: tenant_id,
        name: "tenant_#{tenant_id}",
        username_policy: @default_username_policy,
        password_policy: @default_password_policy,
        max_sessions: 5
      }
    end
  end

  defmodule PolicyEngine do
    @moduledoc "Evaluates tenant-specific security policies."

    # Builds a composite validation regex from tenant display name rules.
    # Tenant admins can configure display name formats.
    def build_display_name_validator(tenant_config) do
      base_pattern = tenant_config.name
        |> normalize_tenant_name()
        |> derive_namespace_pattern()

      # The composite pattern allows tenant-namespaced display names
      full_pattern = "^(#{base_pattern})(" <> repetition_suffix() <> ")$"
      {:ok, regex} = Regex.compile(full_pattern)
      regex
    end

    defp normalize_tenant_name(name) do
      name
      |> String.downcase()
      |> String.replace(~r/[^a-z0-9_]/, "")
    end

    # Derives a pattern that matches the tenant namespace prefix
    defp derive_namespace_pattern(normalized_name) do
      # Allow the tenant name or common variations
      escaped = Regex.escape(normalized_name)
      "(?:#{escaped}|#{escaped}[._])?"
    end

    # Suffix pattern for the user-chosen portion of display names
    # Allows word characters, spaces, and common punctuation
    defp repetition_suffix do
      # This pattern uses atomic grouping to prevent backtracking
      # of display names with optional groupings
      "[\\w .]{1,128}"
    end
  end

  defmodule SessionStore do
    @moduledoc "In-memory session store with tenant isolation."
    use Agent

    def start_link(_opts) do
      Agent.start_link(fn -> %{} end, name: __MODULE__)
    end

    def create_session(tenant_id, user_id, metadata \\ %{}) do
      session_id = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
      session = %{
        id: session_id,
        tenant_id: tenant_id,
        user_id: user_id,
        created_at: DateTime.utc_now(),
        metadata: metadata
      }
      Agent.update(__MODULE__, fn state ->
        tenant_sessions = Map.get(state, tenant_id, %{})
        user_sessions = Map.get(tenant_sessions, user_id, [])
        updated_user_sessions = [session | user_sessions]
        updated_tenant = Map.put(tenant_sessions, user_id, updated_user_sessions)
        Map.put(state, tenant_id, updated_tenant)
      end)
      {:ok, session_id}
    end

    def get_sessions(tenant_id, user_id) do
      Agent.get(__MODULE__, fn state ->
        state
        |> Map.get(tenant_id, %{})
        |> Map.get(user_id, [])
      end)
    end

    def validate_isolation(session_id, claimed_tenant_id) do
      Agent.get(__MODULE__, fn state ->
        case find_session(state, session_id) do
          {:ok, session} -> session.tenant_id == claimed_tenant_id
          :error -> false
        end
      end)
    end

    defp find_session(state, session_id) do
      result = Enum.find_value(state, fn {_tenant_id, tenant_sessions} ->
        Enum.find_value(tenant_sessions, fn {_user_id, sessions} ->
          Enum.find(sessions, fn s -> s.id == session_id end)
        end)
      end)
      if result, do: {:ok, result}, else: :error
    end
  end

  defmodule Authenticator do
    @moduledoc "Main authentication module with multi-tenant support."

    alias MultiTenant.Auth.{TenantConfig, PolicyEngine, SessionStore}

    @tenant_registry %{
      "acme" => TenantConfig.default_config("acme"),
      "globex" => TenantConfig.default_config("globex"),
      "initech" => TenantConfig.default_config("initech")
    }

    def authenticate(tenant_id, username, password, display_name \\ nil) do
      with {:ok, tenant} <- resolve_tenant(tenant_id),
           :ok <- validate_username(tenant, username),
           :ok <- validate_display_name(tenant, display_name),
           {:ok, user_id} <- verify_credentials(tenant_id, username, password) do
        SessionStore.create_session(tenant_id, user_id, %{display_name: display_name})
      end
    end

    defp resolve_tenant(tenant_id) do
      case Map.get(@tenant_registry, tenant_id) do
        nil -> {:error, :tenant_not_found}
        config -> {:ok, config}
      end
    end

    defp validate_username(tenant, username) do
      if Regex.match?(tenant.username_policy, username) do
        :ok
      else
        {:error, :invalid_username}
      end
    end

    defp validate_display_name(_tenant, nil), do: :ok
    defp validate_display_name(tenant, display_name) do
      validator = PolicyEngine.build_display_name_validator(tenant)
      # Apply the tenant-specific display name validation
      if Regex.match?(validator, display_name) do
        :ok
      else
        {:error, :invalid_display_name}
      end
    end

    defp verify_credentials(tenant_id, username, password) do
      # In production, this queries a tenant-isolated database and verifies
      # the stored Argon2 hash. Argon2.verify_pass performs a constant-time,
      # salted, memory-hard comparison. Argon2.no_user_verify mitigates user
      # enumeration by running a dummy verification when no user is found.
      case lookup_password_hash(tenant_id, username) do
        nil ->
          Argon2.no_user_verify()
          {:error, :invalid_credentials}

        stored_hash ->
          if Argon2.verify_pass(password, stored_hash) do
            {:ok, "#{tenant_id}:#{username}"}
          else
            {:error, :invalid_credentials}
          end
      end
    end

    defp lookup_password_hash(_tenant_id, _username) do
      # Placeholder - would query tenant-isolated database and return the
      # stored Argon2 hash string, or nil if the user does not exist.
      Argon2.hash_pwd_salt("placeholder")
    end
  end
end
